K01-pos1.label: violation
K01-pos1.note: invoicing imports the workorders domain aggregate directly and uses its fields.

K01-pos2.label: violation
K01-pos2.note: workorders imports the properties in-memory repository (infrastructure internals) and calls it.

K01-twin1.label: clean
K01-twin1.note: Invoicing drafts from a work order view taken from the workorders contracts.

K01-twin2.label: clean
K01-twin2.note: Workorders asks the properties context through its index.ts public API.

K01-legit.label: clean
K01-legit.note: Invoicing imports a property summary type through the properties public API (directory import of index.ts).

K02-pos1.label: violation
K02-pos1.note: The Invoice aggregate imports the infrastructure in-memory repository and calls it.

K02-pos2.label: violation
K02-pos2.note: The Property aggregate imports the axios HTTP package to geocode itself.

K02-twin1.label: clean
K02-twin1.note: The id sequence is a pure aggregate function; the service reads the count from the repository port.

K02-twin2.label: clean
K02-twin2.note: Coordinates are set on the aggregate as plain values; any geocoding stays outside the domain.

K02-legit.label: clean
K02-legit.note: The domain uses the shared-kernel Money value object.

K03-pos1.label: violation
K03-pos1.note: replaceWorkOrder saves the cancelled work order and its successor in one command.

K03-pos2.label: violation
K03-pos2.note: transferUnit saves both the source and the target property.

K03-twin1.label: clean
K03-twin1.note: The command cancels and saves one work order; a handler opens the successor on the published event.

K03-twin2.label: clean
K03-twin2.note: The command saves the source property and publishes an event; a handler adds the unit to the target.

K03-legit.label: clean
K03-legit.note: The command reads two properties but changes and saves only the target one.

K04-pos1.label: violation
K04-pos1.note: The work order repository gains saveBoth (two aggregates at once) and supersedeWorkOrder calls it.

K04-pos2.label: violation
K04-pos2.note: The property repository gains saveAll (several aggregates at once) and swapUnits calls it.

K04-twin1.label: clean
K04-twin1.note: The command cancels and saves one work order and publishes the successor request; no multi-aggregate repository method exists.

K04-twin2.label: clean
K04-twin2.note: The command saves one property through the single-aggregate repository method and publishes the handed-over unit as an event.

K04-legit.label: clean
K04-legit.note: The repository method persists one property together with its inner unit entities and the command calls it.

K05-pos1.label: violation
K05-pos1.note: A workorders command synchronously records a maintenance visit on the Property through PropertyService.

K05-pos2.label: violation
K05-pos2.note: An invoicing command synchronously cancels the WorkOrder through WorkOrderService.

K05-twin1.label: clean
K05-twin1.note: The command completes and saves one work order and publishes the event that the properties context handles.

K05-twin2.label: clean
K05-twin2.note: The command cancels and saves one invoice and publishes InvoiceCancelled for other contexts to handle.

K05-legit.label: clean
K05-legit.note: The command only queries the properties public API and then saves its own work order.

K06-pos1.label: violation
K06-pos1.note: A function in main.ts completes the work order and records the visit on the property.

K06-pos2.label: violation
K06-pos2.note: A function in main.ts deactivates the property and cancels the work order.

K06-twin1.label: clean
K06-twin1.note: main.ts only subscribes a handler; workorders cancels its own work order when an invoice is cancelled.

K06-twin2.label: clean
K06-twin2.note: main.ts only subscribes a handler; invoicing cancels its own invoice when a work order is cancelled.

K06-legit.label: clean
K06-legit.note: main.ts only wires: a small helper that subscribes handlers, with no write of its own.

K07-pos1.label: violation
K07-pos1.note: reassignContractor calls the notifier port inside the transaction callback.

K07-pos2.label: violation
K07-pos2.note: closeAndNotify calls the notifier port inside the transaction callback.

K07-twin1.label: clean
K07-twin1.note: reassignContractor notifies the contractor after the transaction has committed.

K07-twin2.label: clean
K07-twin2.note: closeAndNotify reads the contractor inside the transaction and notifies after commit.

K07-legit.label: clean
K07-legit.note: The port call sits lexically inside an arrow function, but the function runs after the transaction commits.

K08-pos1.label: violation
K08-pos1.note: The service compares the estimate with the work order budget; the aggregate setter enforces nothing.

K08-pos2.label: violation
K08-pos2.note: The service checks invoice status and line count; Invoice.release enforces nothing.

K08-twin1.label: clean
K08-twin1.note: The aggregate rejects an estimate over budget; the service only loads, delegates and saves.

K08-twin2.label: clean
K08-twin2.note: Invoice.release enforces draft status and non-empty lines; the service only delegates.

K08-legit.label: clean
K08-legit.note: The service validates only that the id is non-empty; the name rule lives in Property.rename.

K09-pos1.label: violation
K09-pos1.note: The service re-checks cost against budget, which WorkOrder.complete also enforces.

K09-pos2.label: violation
K09-pos2.note: The service re-checks the 20-line limit that Invoice.addLine also enforces.

K09-twin1.label: clean
K09-twin1.note: A batch completion only calls completeWorkOrder; the budget rule stays in the aggregate.

K09-twin2.label: clean
K09-twin2.note: A batch add of lines only calls addLine; the line limit stays in Invoice.

K09-legit.label: clean
K09-legit.note: The service rejects an empty label (an input rule no aggregate checks); the unit rules stay in Property.

K10-pos1.label: violation
K10-pos1.note: The service throws on a duplicate unit id, the set invariant Property owns.

K10-pos2.label: violation
K10-pos2.note: The controller returns an error result for a duplicate unit id without throwing, outside Property.

K10-twin1.label: clean
K10-twin1.note: A batch add only calls addUnit; Property.addUnit rejects duplicates.

K10-twin2.label: clean
K10-twin2.note: The controller delegates to the service and maps its error to a result; no duplicate check of its own.

K10-legit.label: clean
K10-legit.note: The declared uniqueness invariant (invoice per work order, enforced by the store) is checked through the repository in the service.

K11-pos1.label: violation
K11-pos1.note: The service serialises completion of a work order with its own in-process lock set.

K11-pos2.label: violation
K11-pos2.note: The repository adapter serialises writes of a property with an in-process lock set.

K11-twin1.label: clean
K11-twin1.note: Stale completion is rejected by the WorkOrder aggregate through a revision it owns; the service takes no lock.

K11-twin2.label: clean
K11-twin2.note: The Property aggregate rejects a stale visit count itself; the service takes no lock.

K11-legit.label: clean
K11-legit.note: A guard flag surrounds a summary cache refresh only; no aggregate is written.

K12-pos1.label: violation
K12-pos1.note: The service computes labour cost with a surcharge from the work order budget and writes it back to the aggregate.

K12-pos2.label: violation
K12-pos2.note: The service computes a late surcharge from the invoice total and writes it back as a line.

K12-twin1.label: clean
K12-twin1.note: WorkOrder computes its labour cost with surcharge; the service only delegates.

K12-twin2.label: clean
K12-twin2.note: Invoice computes its late surcharge; the service only delegates.

K12-legit.label: clean
K12-legit.note: The service formats the invoice total for display and writes nothing.

K13-pos1.label: violation
K13-pos1.note: The out-port method takes MailMessage from the ambient mailer-sdk shim.

K13-pos2.label: violation
K13-pos2.note: The out-port method takes the concrete InMemoryInvoiceRepository adapter class and a SqlTransaction handle.

K13-twin1.label: clean
K13-twin1.note: The mail port uses only primitive types; the adapter implements it.

K13-twin2.label: clean
K13-twin2.note: The export port takes the InvoiceView contract DTO; the adapter implements it.

K13-legit.label: clean
K13-legit.note: The port takes the Property aggregate and primitives, all domain-side types.

K14-pos1.label: violation
K14-pos1.note: The public index re-exports the Property aggregate type.

K14-pos2.label: violation
K14-pos2.note: A published contract returns the Invoice aggregate itself.

K14-twin1.label: clean
K14-twin1.note: The published contract exposes a WorkOrderDetail DTO and the service builds it.

K14-twin2.label: clean
K14-twin2.note: The published lookup contract returns the InvoiceView DTO.

K14-legit.label: clean
K14-legit.note: The contract declares its own PropertyDetail DTO built from UnitSnapshot DTOs; no entity is exposed.

K15-pos1.label: violation
K15-pos1.note: InvoiceService is injected with the concrete InMemoryInvoiceRepository instead of the port.

K15-pos2.label: violation
K15-pos2.note: WorkOrderService constructs a RecordingContractorNotifier adapter itself for escalations.

K15-twin1.label: clean
K15-twin1.note: The escalation goes through the injected ContractorNotifier port.

K15-twin2.label: clean
K15-twin2.note: The service answers an existence query through the injected repository port.

K15-legit.label: clean
K15-legit.note: main.ts builds the invoice repository adapter and injects it into the service.

K16-pos1.label: violation
K16-pos1.note: The Invoice aggregate holds a WorkOrder root object in a field.

K16-pos2.label: violation
K16-pos2.note: The WorkOrder aggregate holds a Property root object in a field.

K16-twin1.label: clean
K16-twin1.note: Invoice references the source work order by id only.

K16-twin2.label: clean
K16-twin2.note: WorkOrder references the related property by id only.

K16-legit.label: clean
